intro: We regularly offer lectures, seminars and lab courses at the LMU Faculty of Physics. Students interested in Bachelor or Master theses in our labs are welcome to contact us at any time.

courses.title: Quantum computing and quantum simulation with atoms
courses.description: This course covers applications of ultracold neutral atoms for quantum technologies, with the main focus on quantum simulation and quantum computation. Atoms provide many opportunities for the realization of high-fidelity qubits across different energy scales, ranging from the microwave to the optical domain.

courses.title: Laser cooling of rubidium atoms in a magneto-optical trap
courses.description: Practical lab course within the Master's Program Quantum Science & Technology, open to all Physics Master and Bachelor students.
